ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with high-intensity (white) pixel regions comprising approximately 10-15% of the visible fluke area, primarily localized at the distal tips and specific focal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity mapping across the main body; high-contrast white geometric blobs localized at the extreme lateral tips [far left and far right]; discrete white focal spots situated in the mid-left lobe and multiple high-contrast linear clusters on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35-40 degrees and a vertical depth extending significantly toward the peduncle connection point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged topography with frequent high-amplitude peaks and valleys; notable deep indentation (tear) located on the medial section of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lower boundary sweeping upward and outward to form a broad, flattened horizontal orientation at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white pixel clusters at the far-left and far-right distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization patterns; small isolated circular white rosettes on the lower-left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned high-contrast white linear disruptions on the right lobe, including a prominent '7'-shaped mark and a series of vertical parallel marks resembling rake signatures.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular erosion and serration of the trailing edge boundary; heavy white scarring and texture distortion at both distal lobal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique sequence of high-contrast white markings on the outer-right lobe that visually resemble a string of characters (appearing as 'I P P H' or similar rake-mark configurations).
